title: Donor-free acceptor-domain control for D18/PY-IT/eC9 causal attribution
changed_evidentiary_state: The commercial bridge now has a prospective control that can distinguish an interface-specific D18/PY-IT/eC9 effect from a donor-independent acceptor-domain packing/delocalization effect. No physical result is claimed until real donor-free and donor-containing measurements are acquired under frozen analysis rules.

primary_evidence.citation: Hart et al., Molecular factors controlling charge pair generation in organic photovoltaic materials, Nature Materials 25, 1209-1218 (2026)
used_for: experimental precedent for field-dependent IQE/PL/trPL in donor-free NFA devices
evidence that reorganization energy, electronic coupling, energetic disorder, exciton binding and packing jointly influence charge generation
evidence that delocalization is important in a richer charge-generation model
experimental-method precedent that neat-acceptor field response can probe exciton splitting / charge generation
primary_evidence.explicit_nontransfer: The paper does not study eC9/PY-IT mixtures or D18/PY-IT/eC9. Its quantitative field responses are method precedent, not project thresholds.

primary_evidence.citation: Luo et al., Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface, Nature Communications 17 (2026)

method_precedent_numbers.material_system: Y5 single-component acceptor device in Hart et al. 2026
method_precedent_numbers.note: These values establish that field-dependent donor-free NFA charge generation can be experimentally large and measurable. They are not acceptance thresholds for eC9 or PY-IT:eC9.

experimental_groups.composition: PY-IT:eC9 donor-free mixture corresponding to the B1 guest ratio on an acceptor-only basis
experimental_groups.purpose: test whether PY-IT changes acceptor-domain field response without D18

experimental_groups.composition: PY-IT:eC9 donor-free mixture corresponding to the B2 guest ratio on an acceptor-only basis
experimental_groups.purpose: test whether PY-IT changes acceptor-domain field response without D18

donor_free_primary: field-dependent photocurrent IQE or an independently validated charge-generation observable
field/bias calibration with explicit electrostatic assumptions
morphology/packing witness measurement such as GIWAXS when available
donor_containing_link: existing preregistered TDCF and/or bias-dependent PL

empirical_metrics.normalized_cge: CGE(F) must be derived from IQE/PL/trPL only under an explicitly validated kinetic/optical mapping; otherwise report the raw observables separately
empirical_metrics.field_midpoint: F50 is the interpolated field at which a monotonic normalized response reaches 50% of its observed dynamic range; report only if the curve brackets the midpoint and interpolation uncertainty is bounded
empirical_metrics.zero_field_response: Report the donor-free zero-/low-field charge-generation proxy separately; do not infer interface physics from it

physical_thresholds.rule: No synthetic or cross-material numerical value in v3.70 may become a physical acceptance margin. Freeze margins from real A0/B0 repeatability, instrument resolution and prospective power analysis before unblinding A1/A2/B1/B2.

prospective_inference_states.DONOR_FREE_EFFECT_PRESENT: A1/A2 move a donor-free field-response metric beyond its frozen A0-based margin with reproducible same-sign behavior across independent fabrication lots. This establishes a donor-independent acceptor-domain effect but not its microscopic cause.
prospective_inference_states.INTERFACE_SPECIFICITY_STRENGTHENED: A1/A2 remain within frozen donor-free margins while B1/B2 move donor-containing field-generation/voltage-loss observables beyond their frozen B0 margins. This strengthens interface-specific attribution but does not uniquely prove EPC.
prospective_inference_states.MIXED_BULK_INTERFACE_EFFECT: Both donor-free and donor-containing systems move materially. Interface-only attribution is rejected; a mixed packing/delocalization/interface model is required.
prospective_inference_states.NO_RESOLVED_EFFECT: Neither donor-free nor donor-containing arms move beyond frozen capability-aware margins.
prospective_inference_states.INCOMPLETE: Required baselines, hierarchy, field calibration, optical controls or frozen margins are missing.

statistical_hierarchy: material lot -> fabrication lot -> substrate -> device -> session -> field point / optical measurement
independence_rule: Field points, voltage points, PL spectra, transient repeats and multiple pixels are technical repeats, not independent fabrication lots.
strongest_conventional_explanations: PY-IT changes eC9 packing, crystallinity, energetic disorder or electronic coupling in acceptor-rich domains independently of D18 interface EPC.
Selective contacts, field calibration, injection/extraction or optical-field differences create apparent donor-free field-response shifts.
Thickness/absorption changes alter PL/IQE normalization without a change in intrinsic charge-generation kinetics.
A donor-free device architecture may reorganize the film differently from the donor-containing bulk heterojunction, limiting direct quantitative transfer.
falsifier: A reproducible donor-free A1/A2 shift in the same direction as the B1/B2 field-generation change falsifies a purely D18-interface-specific interpretation unless an independent discriminator shows the donor-free shift is irrelevant to the donor-containing mechanism.
next_physical_step: Fabricate and qualify A0/A1/A2 donor-free controls under a selective-contact architecture before B1/B2 mechanism unblinding, then analyze donor-free and donor-containing arms with frozen baseline-derived margins.
safety_notes: Reuse the project's existing solvent, UV/laser, vacuum/electrode, electrical-bias and organic-semiconductor waste controls.
Do not extend electric field merely to match literature values if breakdown, heating, injection or electrochemistry invalidates the measurement regime.
